The '''Yashuvhu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yashuvhu/Legends|Yashuvhu]].
